name: Wild Umbral Tin
tooltip:
Wild Umbral Tin
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Umbral Tin is distinguished from its less impressive cousin by the deep shade of the ore. It resembles the inky black sky. Umbral Tin is more durable yet also more flexible than most other metals.

Zul'Aman is rife with natural magic from the eons that Amani society has lived there. Occasionally, this magic is imbued into ore deposits. Be wary while gathering these deposits, lest Zul'Aman itself fight back.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
